messages:
maya: Heads up — I'm doing a small TF module refactor for networking modules (split vpc -> vpc-core + vpc-attachments). Planning to pin provider versions in the modules and add a compatibility shim so older setups don't break. Quick check: any objections to pinning aws provider to ~> 4.60 in the modules?

samir: sounds reasonable. are you planning to update the root lockfile too or rely on module-level constraints?

maya: goal is module-level constraints + regenerate lockfile in CI. we should avoid forcing root changes for consumers unless necessary.

jordan: +1 for module-level pins. one ask: add a short migration note in the module README about provider aliases and any breaking provider source changes.

maya: noted. I'll include a snippet. also thinking of adding a compat shim: a tiny module that maps old outputs/names to new ones for a release cycle.

samir: nice. for lockfile regen, CI currently runs `terraform providers lock` in the infra repo pipeline — does that handle platform targets? we have darwin/amd64 + linux/amd64 + linux/arm64 entries.

maya: I'll run `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64,darwin_amd64,linux_arm64` locally and push the updated .terraform.lock.hcl in the module repo. CI will validate the lockfile checksum.

jordan: test plan: 1) smoke plan in staging org 2) run k8s deploy pipeline dry-run 3) optional canary apply with a non-prod VPC.

maya: yep. also want a quick eyes on this provider block I'm adding to modules (simple):

```hcl
provider "aws" {
  region = var.region
  version = "~> 4.60"
}
```

any reason not to include version in the module block?

samir: prefer to avoid provider blocks that set credentials or assume backend. version constraint is ok but prefer `required_providers` in module `versions.tf` to centralize. e.g.

```hcl
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = { source = "hashicorp/aws" , version = "~> 4.60" }
  }
}
```

that avoids accidental provider instances in root.

maya: good point — I'll move it to `versions.tf` in each module. will still keep the tiny compat module to expose old outputs.

jordan: also check consumers that use `module.vpc.aws_subnet.*` references — aliasing could change those paths. compat shim should re-export outputs to the old names.

maya: yep will add a mapping like `old_subnet_ids = module.vpc_attachments.subnet_ids` so no immediate TF changes for downstream stacks.

ops-oncall: ops question — will this require a coordinated deploy across accounts? last time a provider source change caused different provider plugin versions in internal tooling.

maya: shouldn't require simultaneous deploys; this is non-breaking with the compat shim. but I'll schedule a short maintenance window for the staging rollout and tag ops.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline triggered: infra-modules/pr-312 — ran `terraform init` + `terraform validate` — 2 warnings (unused var), 0 errors.

samir: thanks. last nit: update our module versioning policy doc to note that module-level provider pins need a minor bump and changelog entry.

maya: will do. I'll push the PR with versions.tf, compat module, README migration steps, and the regenerated .terraform.lock.hcl. ping me for a quick review before merge. :thumbsup:

jordan: can review after lunch.

samir: I'll do a quick lockfile diff for weird platform hashes.

maya: thanks team — putting PR link in thread once ready.
